name: aceternity-ui-animated-tooltip
blurb: Avatar stack with tooltips showing name and designation on hover, tooltips tilt based on cursor position.
description: Renders a list of circular avatar images in an overlapping row. On hover, a tooltip appears above with name and designation, rotating and translating based on mouse movement within the image.
use_when: Team member galleries, contributor lists, or user avatars that need an interactive personal touch.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; relies on hover and mouse movement tracking.
a11y: Images have alt text; tooltips appear on hover only, not accessible via keyboard.

props.name: items
props.type: {id: number, name: string, designation: string, image: string}[]
